# Awesome Agent Skills

[![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

A made-up link list for RAVIS's tests, in the shapes such lists use: list items, a table, badges,
a table of contents, links that aren't skills, and a skill kept outside GitHub.

## Contents

- [Official](#official)
- [Community](#community)

## Official

- **[anthropics/pdf](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/pdf)** - Read and write PDFs.
- [vercel-labs/agent-skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) — Vercel's collection
- [An issue about a skill](https://github.com/o/r/issues/4) - not a skill
- [Hosted elsewhere](https://skills.example.org/cool) - A skill kept on another site.
